description_en: Queries the activation status of Simple Log Service for the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询阿里云日志服务的开通状态
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp get-sls-open-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSlsOpenStatus

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

For more information about the valid values of this parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188196.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所属地域ID。

关于该参数的取值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188196.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

SlsOpenStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether Simple Log Service is activated for the current Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

true: Simple Log Service is activated.
false: Simple Log Service is not activated
SlsOpenStatus.description_zh:
当前阿里云账号是否已开通日志服务。取值：

true：表示已开通日志服务。
false：表示未开通日志服务
